subject: pe
title: Skill & Tactics: Decision Making
welcome_lead: The best players think fast — and pick the right option.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: decision making, options, communication.
final_note: A good decision often beats a great skill.

concepts.def: Choice made in a sport situation.
Look around before you get the ball.

walkthroughs.body_html: Before you get the ball, scan. Where are teammates, opponents and space? Good players look every few seconds.
Always have a plan A and B. Pass, dribble, shoot? Pick the highest-value option for the team.
A quick call — 'time!' or 'man on!' — helps a teammate decide. Loud, short, clear.

mcqs.q: Is a tennis serve a closed or open skill?
options: Open - because tennis is a fast-paced sport.
Closed - performed in a predictable, self-paced environment.
